name: modular-agent
description: A modular framework for building agents with replaceable model, workflow, memory, and application components.

scripts.test:base-composition-qualification: pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-integration-tests... --if-present build && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-composition typecheck && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-integration-tests typecheck && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-composition lint && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-integration-tests lint && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-composition format:check && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-integration-tests format:check && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-composition test && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-integration-tests test && vitest run test/resource-registry-architecture.test.ts test/composition-architecture.test.ts
scripts.test:memory-qualification: pnpm --filter '{./modules/agent-memory/**}...' --if-present build && pnpm --filter './modules/agent-memory/**' typecheck && eslint modules/agent-memory test/memory-architecture.test.ts test/retrieval-memory-architecture.test.ts && prettier --check modules/agent-memory test/memory-architecture.test.ts test/retrieval-memory-architecture.test.ts && pnpm --filter './modules/agent-memory/**' test && vitest run test/memory-architecture.test.ts test/retrieval-memory-architecture.test.ts
scripts.test:workflow-qualification: pnpm --filter '@print-an-agent/workflow-*' --filter '@print-an-agent/base-request...' --if-present build && pnpm --filter '@print-an-agent/workflow-*' typecheck && pnpm --filter '@print-an-agent/workflow-*' lint && pnpm --filter '@print-an-agent/workflow-*' format:check && pnpm --filter '@print-an-agent/workflow-*' test && vitest run test/workflow-architecture.test.ts test/workflow-source-boundaries.test.ts
scripts.test:agent-ui-qualification: pnpm --filter './modules/agent-ui/**' --if-present build && pnpm --filter './modules/agent-ui/**' --if-present typecheck && eslint modules/agent-ui test/architecture.test.ts && prettier --check modules/agent-ui test/architecture.test.ts && pnpm --filter './modules/agent-ui/**' --if-present test && vitest run test/architecture.test.ts
scripts.test: pnpm test:architecture && pnpm -r --if-present test && pnpm python:test
scripts.test:architecture: pnpm -r --if-present build && vitest run test/type-modules.test.ts test/identity-config-architecture.test.ts test/architecture.test.ts test/source-boundaries.test.ts test/session-architecture.test.ts test/composition-architecture.test.ts test/runtime-architecture.test.ts test/request-architecture.test.ts test/tool-architecture.test.ts test/standalone-architecture.test.ts test/local-adapters-architecture.test.ts test/workflow-architecture.test.ts test/workflow-source-boundaries.test.ts test/model-invocation-architecture.test.ts test/memory-architecture.test.ts test/retrieval-memory-architecture.test.ts test/resource-registry-architecture.test.ts test/release-packages.test.ts
scripts.test:model-invocation-qualification: pnpm --filter '@print-an-agent/model-invocation-*' --if-present build && pnpm --filter '@print-an-agent/model-invocation-*' typecheck && eslint modules/model-invocation && prettier --check modules/model-invocation && pnpm --filter '@print-an-agent/model-invocation-*' test && vitest run test/model-invocation-architecture.test.ts
scripts.python:build: uv build modules/model-workbench/templates/python-model-backend/python/template --out-dir temp/python-dist && uv build modules/model-workbench/templates/python-model-backend/python/packages/backend-scaffold --out-dir temp/python-dist && uv build modules/model-workbench/templates/python-model-backend/python/packages/model-backend --out-dir temp/python-dist
scripts.python:test: uv run --directory modules/model-workbench/templates/python-model-backend/python pytest template/tests packages/backend-scaffold/tests packages/model-backend/tests/architecture packages/model-backend/tests/unit packages/model-backend/tests/protocol
scripts.python:test:model-backend: uv run --directory modules/model-workbench/templates/python-model-backend/python --all-packages --all-extras python -c "import torch" && uv run --directory modules/model-workbench/templates/python-model-backend/python --all-packages --all-extras pytest packages/model-backend/tests/model packages/model-backend/tests/integration
scripts.python:validate: pnpm python:format:check && pnpm python:lint && pnpm python:typecheck && pnpm python:test && pnpm python:build
scripts.test:model-backend:smoke: pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/workbench-integration-tests... --if-present build && TA_AGENT_MODEL_BACKEND_REQUIRE_SMOKE=1 pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/workbench-integration-tests exec vitest run test/python-model-backend.test.ts
scripts.validate:model-backend: pnpm python:sync:model-backend && pnpm python:validate && pnpm python:test:model-backend && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/workbench-python-model-backend-template-adapter test && pnpm test:model-backend:smoke
scripts.validate:quick: pnpm format:check && pnpm test:architecture && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-integration-tests exec vitest run test/public-agent-consumer.test.ts test/standalone-provider.test.ts && pnpm python:lint && pnpm python:typecheck && pnpm python:test
scripts.validate: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test:identity-config-qualification: pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-identity-config typecheck && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-identity-config lint && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-identity-config format:check && pnpm --filter @print-an-agent/base-identity-config test && vitest run test/identity-config-architecture.test.ts
